name: File Forwarder
description: Ships demo files from every game host to the site VPS over SFTP every few minutes and deletes delivered raw demos from the host after the retention period. Needs the VPS address saved in Settings (its host keys are scanned then) and the install's SFTP public key added to the VPS once.

global.label: Raw demo retention on the host (days)
Patterns
global.default: *.qlmatch qlmatch keep; *.replay.json.gz qlmatch keep; *.dm_91 raw expire

global.label: internal: install SFTP private key (generated, never shown)

global_settings.description: Where and how every host forwards its demos. A change reaches a host with Apply to host (host menu, File Forwarder) or its next host setup, not with Update Plugins.

fields.label: VPS address
fields.description: SFTP target, a host name or IPv4 address. Saving a new address reads its SSH host keys from QLSM and pins them; compare the fingerprints shown in the status line once with the VPS provider console. Apply to host refuses until this is done.

fields.label: Re-scan host keys
fields.description: Read the VPS host keys again on this save, e.g. after the VPS was reinstalled. Then use Apply to host on every host.

fields.label: Raw demo retention on the host (days)
Raw upload limit per run (MB)
fields.description: Raw demos are sent newest first; the rest waits for the next run.

fields.label: Patterns
fields.default: *.qlmatch qlmatch keep; *.replay.json.gz qlmatch keep; *.dm_91 raw expire
fields.description: Rows of 'glob remote_dir keep|expire' separated by ';'. A remote_dir uses only A-Za-z0-9_.- characters; 'expire' rows are deleted from the host after the retention, once their delivery is recorded and at least 24 hours old.
